name: text-gradient
title: Flowing Gradient Text
description: A huge word filled with a restrained blue gradient that keeps rotating through the letters while the word scales and fades in; three short dashes can fade in below.
useWhen: A title or brand word that should feel alive without moving: the colour flows through it.
A hero card with a quiet, colourful headline.
avoidWhen: A single static fill: use a plain title block.
A one-off highlight sweep across the text: use text-shimmer.
author: lifeprompt-team

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Size of the text in pixels. Longer text shrinks to fit the frame.

variables.label: Gradient color 1
variables.description: First colour of the gradient (it also colours the first dash).

variables.label: Dashes
variables.description: Show the three small dashes under the text.

variables.label: Background
variables.description: Fill behind the text. Use transparent to lay the block over your own footage.
